notes: Card: broad flag 1.5%; ':' x7, ' is' x6, ' now' x3, ' was' x2, mostly in press-release and report prose. Probes: 'therapy is' 0.412, 'program was held' 0.323, 'Program was created' 0.163; the colon in a title only 0.099, a dog sentence 0.025. A guess at the largest cluster; the colon is not covered.
